newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh seizes $1 mln worth of smuggled gold.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh seizes $1 mln worth of smuggled gold.

text.p: Dhaka airport customs on Monday seized nearly $1 million worth of gold believed to have been smuggled into the country by a Bangladeshi travelling from Dubai, airport officials said.
The gold, in the form of 598 bars, was concealed in two suitcases brought in by a man who fled after customs officials became suspicious about his baggage, they said without giving further details.
